# Licence-body fixtures

Real files, copied unmodified from
[solid-hyperobjects](https://github.com/madfam-org/solid-hyperobjects) at commit
`7de3a32e3d3c1e153f15fc763a653eb7c6536457` (main before #177):

| Fixture | Source path | What it is |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `s-body-under-w-title/LICENSE` | `LICENSE` (root; 12 cartridges carried copies) | the CERN-OHL-S-2.0 body under a "Weakly Reciprocal" title — replaced by #177 |
| `w-paraphrase/LICENSE` | `maze/LICENSE` (10 cartridges; also soft-hyperobjects' root `LICENSE`) | a 184-line reworded text titled CERN-OHL-W, not the canonical wording |
| `w-full-github-variants/LICENSE` | `custom-msh/LICENSE` (also `julia-vase`) | the full CERN-OHL-W-2.0 text as GitHub's licence catalogue renders it |

The 27 short notices with the one-slash URL are represented by
`../assembly-golden/commons/ab-drive/LICENSE`, already byte-identical to solid main.
